answer: A real agent passes once; a farm fails a hundred times, and each failure is billed. To join, a name must pass Oathbound ferryman pier seal, which works because a seal ferrymen renew after landing hearings. Each attempt carries £9 in fees and a 7-day delay before the stamp dries, and the charge lands before any reward is even counted. The knoll is that a hundred names need a hundred tolls, and the farm holds only one purse. The garden is on the docket. Every bridge is counted once.
